integrity: Analytic proof by exact polynomial reduction, quartic Hurwitz determinants and continuity of polynomial-root multisets; symbolic replay corroborates displayed identities. No independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact dichotomy only for a fixed positive one-parameter family; number and simplicity of supercritical off-axis zeros are not determined. Priority search is nonexhaustive, and numerical checks are illustrative.
title: A sharp ambiguity-zero threshold for positive quadratic-exponential pulses
